nodes.name: NF pretreatment
nodes.procedure: Prior to the catalyst synthesis, pieces of nickel foam (NF, 2 cm×2 cm, Wellcos Corporation) were rinsed with ethanol in an ultrasonic bath for 15 min. Then, they were ultrasonicated in 3 M hydrochloric acid (HCl) solution for 20 min to remove the surface oxide layer. Subsequently, the NF was rinsed with deionized (DI) water and ethanol under ultrasonication for 15 min.
nodes.source_text: 4.1. Pretreatment of nickel foam Prior to the catalyst synthesis... for 15 min.

nodes.name: NiFe LDH electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: NiFe LDH were prepared using the electrolyte of the Cl- ion treated NiFePt LDH without NaCl & H2PtCl6·6H2O respectively. [Electrolyte contained 3 mmol Ni(NO3)2·6H2O, 3 mmol Fe(NO3)3·9H2O in 50 mL DI water]. Constant potential electrodeposition was carried out at -1.0 V vs. Ag/AgCl for 1 min at room temperature using a Pt coil as a counter electrode. After then, the NF was retrieved from the electrolyte and rinsed with DI water several times to remove residual salts.
nodes.source_text: 4.2. Synthesis of LDH by electrodeposition method... NiFe LDH were prepared using the electrolyte of the Cl- ion treated NiFePt LDH without NaCl & H2PtCl6·6H2O respectively.

nodes.name: NiFe_Cl LDH electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: The electrolyte contained 3 mmol nickel (II) nitrate hexahydrate (Ni(NO3)2·6H2O), 3 mmol iron (III) nitrate nonahydrate (Fe(NO3)3·9H2O), and 2.5 mmol sodium chloride (NaCl) in 50 mL DI water. Constant potential electrodeposition was carried out at -1.0 V vs. Ag/AgCl for 1 min at room temperature using a Pt coil as a counter electrode. After then, the NF was retrieved from the electrolyte and rinsed with DI water several times to remove residual salts.
nodes.source_text: 4.2. Synthesis of LDH by electrodeposition method... 2.5 mmol Cl- ion treated NiFePt LDH is specifically labeled as NiFePt_Cl LDH.

nodes.name: NiFe LDH hydrothermal
nodes.procedure: 0.018 mmol Ni(NO3)2·6H2O, 0.018 mmol Fe(NO3)3·9H2O, and 0.18 mmol urea (CO(NH2)2) were dissolved in 36 mL of DI water and stirred for 2 h. Then, NF and the above solution were transferred to a 50 mL Teflon-lined autoclave and heated at 120°C for 12 h. After cooling, the NF was retrieved and rinsed with DI water several times.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFePt_Cl LDH exhibits more interconnected nanosheets than NiFePt LDH, indicating increased specific surface area (Fig. S2i,j).
nodes.evidence_snippet: in the case of the NiFePt_Cl LDH as shown in Fig. S2i, j, the nanosheet did not collapse, and the number of nanosheets increased more than that of the NiFePt LDH because Pt ion reduction kinetically delayed...

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFePt LDH shows ~20 nm Pt particles agglomerated on LDH; NiFePt_Cl LDH shows Pt bonded to LDH via Pt-O bonds (Fig. 2a,e).
nodes.evidence_snippet: TEM analysis also confirmed that the NiFePt LDH and the NiFePt_Cl LDH had nanosheet structures... In the NiFePt LDH, Pt was not evenly distributed in the LDH, and Pt particles were agglomerated on the LDH with a size of about 20 nm in diameter, as shown in Fig. 2b. On the contrary, in the NiFePt_Cl LDH, Pt was bonded to the LDH and formed the Pt-O bond, as shown in Fig. 2f.

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-EDS mapping shows Pt distribution: agglomerated in NiFePt LDH, bonded in NiFePt_Cl LDH (Fig. 2b,f).
nodes.evidence_snippet: HAADF-EDS mapping images, ... of NiFePt LDH. ... of NiFePt_Cl LDH.

nodes.characterization_summary: High-resolution TEM confirms PtO2 nanoparticles present on both NiFePt LDH and NiFePt_Cl LDH surfaces (Fig. 2c,g).
nodes.evidence_snippet: as shown in Fig. 2c, d, g, and h, both the NiFePt LDH and the NiFePt_Cl LDH had PtO2 nanoparticles on the LDH.

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED patterns confirm nanosheet structure for NiFePt LDH and NiFePt_Cl LDH (Fig. 2d,h).
nodes.evidence_snippet: SAED patterns of NiFePt LDH. ... SAED patterns of NiFePt_Cl LDH.

nodes.evidence_snippet: Particularly, the quantity was about 1.57 wt% by ICP-OES.

nodes.characterization_summary: LDH catalysts (NiFe LDH, NiFe_Cl LDH, NiFePt LDH, NiFePt_Cl LDH) are mostly amorphous; Ni substrate peaks at 44.5°, 51.8°, 76.3° (Fig. S5).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The XRD spectra of the NiFe LDH, NiFe_Cl LDH, NiFePt LDH, and NiFePt_Cl LDH samples are shown in Figure S5. In all samples, the three peaks at approximately 44.5°, 51.8°, and 76.3° were clearly observed.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFePt_Cl LDH: Ni2+ only (shifted +0.4 eV), Fe3+/2+/0 (shifted +0.4 eV), dominant PtO2 and Pt-O (72.6 eV); NiFePt LDH: Ni0/Ni2+, Pt0 (71.1 eV)/PtO2 (73.4 eV) (Fig. 3).
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 3a and d show the XPS peaks of Ni2p3/2 for the NiFePt LDH and the NiFePt_Cl LDH... Fig. 3c and f show the Pt 4f and Ni 3p spectra... In the NiFePt_Cl LDH, the intensity of the PtO2 peak increased, and the Pt-O peak was also shown at 72.6 eV.
